verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve conflicting acquisition records and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Menacing Flare as a Ki Blast Super with a long-range beam, single-hit behavior, knockback, and a teleport follow-up when the initial beam misses.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material lists Skill Shop as the acquisition route. A separate Dragon Ball reference documents later TP Medal Shop availability, so the record preserves both routes rather than treating the older/current sources as interchangeable.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The available evidence establishes shop acquisition rather than a PQ reward condition, but does not independently provide a negative-UF statement, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact percentage damage is not promoted as canonical because the cited current reference gives a listed value without establishing version stability.

records.name: Menacing Flare
records.character_source: Pan and Future Trunks customizable partners
records.unlock_method: Skill Shop; later references also document TP Medal Shop availability
records.source_quest_or_shop: Skill Shop / TP Medal Shop (source history retained)
records.skill_description: A long-range Ki Blast beam Super that, when the initial shot misses, moves the user behind the opponent for a follow-up kick.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies Menacing Flare as a beam, long-range, single-hit Ki Blast Super with knockback and a teleport/pseudo-Strike follow-up. If the initial beam connects, the follow-up does not occur. The Dragon Ball reference documents TP Medal Shop availability and partner customization for Pan and Future Trunks in later updates.
